title: Verify the corrected sitemap is live
action: Open https://terminaljetaime.com/sitemap.xml. It should list the homepage once, without #faq or other section fragments. If the old version remains, check the Railway deployment for the latest main commit.
done: The live sitemap matches the corrected repository version.

title: Check the memory command on macOS
action: Check the System category on the homepage. If it still lists free -h, ask me to replace it with a documented macOS command and verify the description. This command is not included with standard macOS.
done: The live page uses a verified macOS memory command.

title: Choose how to measure human visits
action: Tell me which analytics service you already use, or whether you want help choosing one. We need page views and organic sessions separately from Search Console clicks and bot requests.
done: An analytics source is connected and a dated baseline is recorded.

title: Choose the first useful macOS guide
action: Review Search Console queries with impressions. Choose one question the site can answer well, such as using pbcopy/pbpaste or caffeinate. Send me the query so I can prepare an original guide with tested examples and links from the cheat sheet.
done: One query and guide topic are selected from evidence; if data is unavailable, the topic is explicitly marked as a hypothesis.
